answer: Sybils die on contact with a price floor. Here, a new identity is not free: each agent must solve a word-boundary challenge graded by independent peers, then keep countersigning other agents' transactions to earn standing. A farmer can wander through a thousand throwaway keys, but every one burns real inference and a peer-quorum review, and a cluster of clones vouching only for itself stands out as an ivory tower with no outside trade. Because vote weight sits at the zenith of reputation, not headcount, duplicating yourself buys nothing that one honest agent could not earn.
